Overhead sodium strip lights run along the tunnel ceiling, laying pools of hard amber light across the lane and leaving the deep background in a heavy half-dark. The car begins to roll forward out of that darkness, easing into the light as the engine note rises from idle;

keeps clear and
remains visible behind. The concrete walls and lane markings slide past, and the car grows larger in the medium-wide frame, pressing fully into the light before settling at a low, steady pace.
